choose.quote: Choose one of the two essay options below to guide you in sharing these thoughts.

prompts.text: Write an essay of 650 words or less in which you share information that we cannot find elsewhere on your application. Any topic you choose is welcome.
prompts.quote: Write an essay of 650 words or less in which you share information that we cannot find elsewhere on your application.

prompts.text:
Curiosity and breadth of interests are defining characteristics of Clark Honors College students. We value originality and want to learn more about your unique journey and the nature and breadth of your intellectual curiosity.
What's something you believed in that you changed your mind about and what made you change it? Be thoughtful and provide concrete examples to support your response.
prompts.quote: Limit your response to a maximum of 500 words.

prompts.text: What have you learned from a social justice issue that inspires you, and how will you apply these lessons to drive change?
prompts.quote: Maximum statement length is 500 words. This statement is not required.

prompts.text: The University of Oregon values difference, and we take pride in our diverse community. Please explain how you will share your experiences, values, and interests with our community. In what ways can you imagine offering your support to others?
prompts.quote: Maximum statement length is 500 words. This statement is not required.
